thread:
jason: Hey team — small proposal to add two deploy-bot subcommands and a lightweight template for staged pinning + fast rollback. Want to iterate before I open a PR.

maria: 👍 always wanted clearer flags for pinning. quick q: can this enforce change windows?

jason: Yes — plan is a --window flag that validates against the org change-window calendar and refuses out-of-window runs unless forced by a senior oncall.

amanda: Can we also add a preflight check that runs smoke tests and checks KV cache warmup percentage? We hit cold cache flakiness last week.

jason: yep. thinking of a small preflight hook that returns nonzero if critical checks fail. Example CLI: 
```
/deploy start --template staged-pin --version v1.4.2 --window 2026-04-01T02:00Z/2026-04-01T04:00Z --canary 10%
```
This would: create canary at 10%, wait 5m, run smoke suite, then ramp.

sre_ops: Important: preflight must include routing policy check (fallback regions) and memory headroom for serving nodes. Add that to the smoke list.

deploy-bot: automated: noted. adding checks: routing_policy, memory_headroom, kv_cache_warmup.

maria: Another request — add a --pin-mode flag: soft|hard. Soft pins prefer the given version but allow fallback to tested variants; hard pins force all traffic to the specified build and block auto-fallback.

jason: good call. default soft. hard requires a signed release note and explicit approval in the command: --approved-by @release-qa

release-qa: Quick note: approvals should land in a single-line release note field so we can attach to audit logs. Example: 
```
/deploy start --template staged-pin --version v1.4.2 --pin-mode hard --approved-by @release-qa --note 'Hotfix: token handling regression, approved by QA'
```

amanda: rollback ergonomics are also rough. can we add a one-liner emergency rollback command that does minimal steps and tags the incident? e.g. 
```
/deploy rollback --to v1.4.1 --reason '500s on billing' --incident TICKET-1234 --force-exec
```
The bot should optionally open an incident and annotate the deployment timeline.

deploy-bot: automated: implemented prototype: rollback will create a rollback-run artifact, log to audit, and if --incident is present, call the incident api. Requires 2 approvals for cross-region rollback.

sre_ops: We should add a dry-run mode that prints the steps and the expected routing changes without applying. Example: --dry-run | --plan-only

jason: Agreed. Also adding templated release notes and a short CLI helper to generate release-note skeleton from changelog entry: 
```
/deploy generate-note --changelog 7a2f3c --type patch --template staging-release
```

maria: How do we prevent accidental hard pins during a change window? Maybe require an env var or a token that only oncall has.

amanda: Or require interactive confirmation when --pin-mode hard is used: bot posts a thread asking for ack from @sre_ops and @release-qa, and waits 2m. If no ack, abort.

jason: That interactive flow is doable. Will prototype using the existing deploy-bot modal flow. If approved, bot returns a signed token which becomes part of the audit.

release-qa: For rollout templates, can we add a small JSON/YAML template library in the repo? Keep them tiny: canary windows, checklists, rollback steps. Then command can do --template name and we avoid repeating flags.

jason: that's the plan. I'll add templates/staged-pin.yaml + templates/emergency-rollback.yaml to the releases repo. Will also add unit tests for the preflight hooks.

amanda: One more: include an output of cost estimate for the change (extra nodes, expected token costs) in the plan. Ops asked for that last quarter.

sre_ops: +1. if cost delta > X%, require finance ack for non-security changes.

deploy-bot: automated: prototype help text: 
```
/deploy start --help
Usage: deploy start [--template NAME] [--version VER] [--pin-mode soft|hard] [--window START/END] [--canary PERCENT] [--dry-run] [--approved-by @user] [--note 'text']
```

jason: I'll open a draft PR with the command schema, templates, and a tiny node preflight script. tagging @maria @amanda for review. Want to ship the first version in the next milestone.

maria: ack. please include migration notes for existing scripts and a fallback roadmap in case bot changes break legacy deploy scripts.

amanda: thanks — I'll draft the rollback runbook update after the PR lands.

release-qa: I'll prepare the short checklist for staged-pin verification.

jason: great. if no objections i'll open the PR this afternoon.

sre_ops: no objections from ops. please include monitoring dashboards to watch during ramp.

jason: noted. PR incoming. :rocket:
